def transform(grid):
    sep_rows=[i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1]
    sep_color=grid[sep_rows[0]][0]

    rr=[]; s=0
    for i in sep_rows: rr.append((s,i)); s=i+1
    rr.append((s,len(grid)))
    sc=[c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if all(grid[r][c]==sep_color for r in range(len(grid)) if r not in sep_rows)]
    cc=[]; s=0
    for i in sc: cc.append((s,i)); s=i+1
    cc.append((s,len(grid[0])))
    return [[(1 if sum(grid[r][c]==obj for r in range(a,b) for c in range(x,y))>=2 else bg) for x,y in cc] for a,b in rr]
